thread:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager fired: service=prod-scheduler (svc-1234) -> escalation=infra-oncall at 2026-03-10T02:12:25Z. Link: https://pd.example/INCIDENTS/INC-98765
jamie-ops: Acking — I'm on it. quick check: is this supposed to go to prod-scheduler or prod-scheduler-private? this looks noisy. :thinking_face:
matt-oncall: I saw a flood of pages, acking now. not seeing matching alert in datadog for prod-scheduler metrics, looks like PD routed to legacy binding `svc-1234-legacy`?
ria-sre: Confirming: we just rotated oncall bindings last night. I think a previous terraform deploy left an extra binding for `svc-1234` pointing at the old `infra-oncall-legacy` policy.
sarah-support: Customer impact — support dashboard shows a spike in 503 errors for the scheduler API for 02:10–02:22 UTC, ~1.2% of requests. Tickets starting to trickle in. Flagging for incident classification T2.
alex-eng: Repro logs: see last deploy logs, there's a `bind-service` job that ran at 01:58. grep shows `bind svc-1234 -> infra-oncall-legacy` in `/var/log/cicd/bind.log`
```
2026-03-10T01:58:12 bind-job: binding svc-1234 -> infra-oncall-legacy
2026-03-10T01:58:15 bind-job: success
```
jamie-ops: Quick mitigation steps: 1) silence legacy service in PD to stop noise 2) rebind svc-1234 -> infra-oncall (correct policy) 3) verify alerting/monitoring. I'm going to silence the service for 30m now.
pagerduty-bot: Service "prod-scheduler-legacy" (svc-1234-legacy) muted by jamie-ops for 30 minutes.
matt-oncall: Thanks — can someone run the PD CLI bind to swap to the intended escalation policy? I don't want the CI job to reapply the bad binding while we patch it.
ria-sre: Running manual bind now and creating a temporary lock in terraform state to prevent the deploy from overwriting.
```
pd service update --service svc-1234 --escalation-policy infra-oncall --note "manual hotfix: incorrect legacy binding"
```
alex-eng: I added an emergency gate in CI: changed `bind-job` to check for `ci-hotfix-lock` tag. Pushing change to staging now.
sarah-support: Customer comms: posting an update to status page: "Short-lived routing issue caused duplicate pages; workaround in progress; some customers saw transient 503s. Investigating." :loudspeaker:
jamie-ops: Confirming: PD binding now points to `infra-oncall`. Re-enabled alerts. Monitoring shows pages stopped.
matt-oncall: Acks cleared. Postmortem owner? I can take initial write-up but want ops + eng action items split.
jamie-ops: I'll own the postmortem doc and schedule. Initial cause: stale legacy PD binding left by a previous deploy; CI did not validate idempotent binding state. Impact: noisy pages to wrong rotation, ~12 minutes of customer-facing 503s, ~5 support tickets.
ria-sre: Action items (short): [1] add PD binding verification step in CI (`pd service get` compare) [2] make `bind-job` idempotent and robust to duplicate entries [3] add an integration test that validates service->escalation mapping before deploy [4] run a one-off scan for any services with multiple bindings.
alex-eng: I'll file a follow-up PR for the CI check and schedule a canary for the binding job.
sarah-support: I'll consolidate customer ticket list and make sure impacted customers get follow-up once root cause and ETA for fix are clear.
jamie-ops: ETA for full fix: 48 hours for CI/test changes + one-off cleanup script. Postmortem meeting scheduled: 2026-03-11 15:00 UTC. Inviting oncall rotation and release owners.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-98765 closed by jamie-ops at 2026-03-10T03:02:25Z (notes: manual rebind + CI gate applied).
matt-oncall: Nice work. Please add runbook step: verify `pd service get --service` after any binding-run, and add a low-noise smoke check that fires to the expected rotation only.
jamie-ops: Will update runbook and attach remediation steps in the postmortem doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
